Logger info reference

Generated from output_schema.yaml

logger_info.Rmd

Information about logging session

  • logger_serial_no

    type: string

    Logger serial number.

  • logger_id

    type: string

    Unique internal database ID of logger.

  • starttime_gmt

    type: datetime

    Date time at which logger began recording data.

  • logging_mode

    type: string

    Mode in which logger was set to record.

  • producer

    type: string

    Logger manufacturer.

  • logger_model

    type: string

    Logger model.

  • production_year

    type: integer

    Year in which logger was manufactured.

  • session_id

    type: string

    Unique ID for each time a logger was deployed.

  • project

    type: string

    Name of the project that this session was part of.

  • deployment_date

    type: date

    Date when the logger was deployed.

  • retrieval_date

    type: date

    Date when the logger was retrieved.

  • started_by

    type: string

    Name of person who started this logger.

  • started_where

    type: string

    Location logger was started, e.g. ‘Tromsø’.

  • days_delayed

    type: integer

    Number of days logger was delayed before it started recording data.

  • programmed_gmt_time

    type: integer

    Date time at which logger was programmed. If a logger was programmed with a delay, starttime_gmt will be this date time + days_delayed.

  • individ_id

    type: string

    Unique ID for each individual.

  • intended_species

    type: string

    English name of the planned deployment species.

  • intended_location

    type: string

    Planned deployment location.

  • intended_deployer

    type: string

    Planned deployer.

  • deployment_species

    type: string

    English name of the species on which the logger was deployed.

  • colony

    type: string

    Name of the colony where the logger was deployed and retrieved. Note that a SEATRACK colony name can cover several locations

  • location

    type: string

    Name of the location where the logger was deployed and retrieved. Note that a SEATRACK colony name can cover several locations

  • nest_id

    type: string

    Identifier for the nest of the individual on which logger was deployed.

  • nest_latitude

    type: float

    Latitude of the nest of the individual on which logger was deployed.

  • nest_longitude

    type: float

    Longitude of the nest of the individual on which logger was deployed.

  • download_type

    type: string

    Logger data download status.

  • download_date

    type: date

    Date logger data was downloaded.

  • shutdown_date

    type: date

    Date logger was shutdown.

  • decomissioned

    type: NA

    Not used.

  • field_status

    type: NA

    Not used.

  • nest_id

    type: string

    Identifier for the nest of the individual from which logger was retrieved.

  • nest_latitude

    type: float

    Latitude of the nest of the individual from which logger was retrieved.

  • nest_longitude

    type: float

    Longitude of the nest of the individual from which logger was retrieved.

  • deployment_type

    type: string

    Type of logger deployment (first deployment of logger, recapture and logger swapped, etc.).
